One of the biggest strengths of the institute is its strict discipline and study-oriented environment. This is helpful for students who are serious about NEET preparation. However, the batch size is quite large, so individual attention is somewhat limited.

I would say this institute is a good option for self-motivated students who can study independently. Parents should visit the specific branch and understand the faculty and batch size before taking admission.

Overall, a decent institute with good discipline, but improvement is needed in personalized attention.
